values.note: Reserve through the campground host (bindercamper@gmail.com or 573-536-9470) up to a year ahead; pay in full when booking ($30 deposit for bookings a year out). Two-night minimum on holiday weekends. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 1 pm; extended stays by application.

note: City of Jefferson (JC Parks) campground in wooded Binder Park, with 17 full-hookup RV sites; reserve through the campground host. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35/day, 17 full-hookup sites, year-round, showers/laundry/WiFi/$10 dump, host reservations, 14-day limit (May 2026 Wayback capture; live site Cloudflare-blocked); waterfront lakeview -> not waterfront (pads in woods ~300 m from Binder Lake).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront: imagery shows the RV pads along the south side of a wooded loop around the bathhouse (~38.5894,-92.3025); Binder Lake's east shore is ~300 m west, past the check-in area, the park road, an open field and a marsh, all through trees. No pad has a lake view. The stored lakeview had no per-entry evidence (commit 0a7a623 bulk value).
